_note: Pro forma cost defaults for Allegheny County. Every value is editable in the app and carries its source label. Money is US dollars; shares are decimals (0.08 = 8%). A value of null means the item has no default yet: when it applies to a project, the pro forma lists it as 'Not included' instead of counting it as zero.

construction._note: Base construction cost per finished (livable) square foot, above a standard foundation. Includes builder overhead and profit. Excludes land, demolition, unusual site or foundation work, and soft costs.

costPerSf.sourceNote: Published per-square-foot ranges from Pittsburgh-area home builders (Incline Homes 2026; Home Builder Digest survey of Pittsburgh builders; EcoCraft).

nationalReference.label: National average construction cost
nationalReference.sourceLabel: NAHB Cost of Constructing a Home 2024 (national reference, not a Pittsburgh default)
nationalReference.sourceNote: Production builders, construction cost only; excludes builder overhead and profit. Shown for comparison only.

garageLevelShareOfTier.label: Tuck-under garage level cost (share of the tier rate per sq ft)
garageLevelShareOfTier.sourceNote: Unfinished garage floor: structure, slab and door, no interior finishes.

construction.rehabNote: No local rehab cost is set yet, so the rehab budget is not estimated. Enter your rehab cost (per sq ft or per home) to price it; new-construction rates are never used for a rehab.

siteAdders._note: Added on top of the base construction cost. The pro forma lists each adder that fired and why.

moderateSlope.label: Moderate slope (8–25%) foundation and site work

trigger._note: Fires when the average 1 m lidar slope is at least 8% and the steep adder does not fire.

steepSlope.label: Steep slope (25% or more): stepped foundation, retaining walls

trigger._note: Fires when at least half of the slope cells are steeper than 25%, or the average slope is 25% or more.

mineGrouting.label: Mine subsidence: grouting (lump sum)
mineGrouting.sourceNote: Editable default, not a quote. Actual cost depends on mine depth and lot size.

mineInsurance.label: Mine subsidence insurance (yearly premium)
mineInsurance.sourceNote: Premium computed from the PA DEP rate chart in the finance module; coverage is set to the construction cost, within the chart's limits.

dumpstersAndStreetPermit.label: Dumpsters and DOMI street-occupancy permit (no on-site staging)
dumpstersAndStreetPermit.sourceNote: DOMI fee schedule applies inside the City of Pittsburgh.

softCosts._note: Shares of hard cost (construction plus site lines).

architectureEngineering.label: Architecture and engineering
architectureEngineering.sourceNote: Custom and hillside projects sit at the high end.

permitsAndFees.label: Permits and fees
permitsAndFees.sourceNote: Used where the permit fee cannot be computed from a published schedule.

pittsburghBuildingPermitFee.label: Pittsburgh residential building permit fee
pittsburghBuildingPermitFee.sourceLabel: Pittsburgh PLI residential base permit fee (verify with PLI schedule)
pittsburghBuildingPermitFee.sourceNote: Reported base fee effective 2026-01-01. Other City fees (zoning, plan review add-ons, DOMI) are not included.

surveyTitleLegalInsurance.label: Survey, title, legal and builder's risk insurance

gcFee.label: General contractor fee (only when trade-level costs are entered)
gcFee.sourceNote: Not applied to the base tiers, which already include builder overhead and profit.

contingency._note: Share of hard cost. Hillside applies when a slope adder fires or the lot is in a landslide-prone or undermined area; rehab applies to the rehab option.

financing._note: Construction financing = loan × average share drawn × rate × construction months ÷ 12 (finance module).

rateSpreadOverPrime.label: Construction loan rate above the prime rate
rateSpreadOverPrime.sourceNote: Added to the Bank Prime Loan Rate (Federal Reserve, via FRED series DPRIME) stored in our database.

loanToCost.label: Construction loan as a share of cost (LTC)

averageDrawShare.label: Average share of the loan drawn while building
averageDrawShare.sourceNote: Draws rise from zero to the full loan, so the average balance is about half.

loanFeeShare.label: Lender fees as a share of the loan

approvalMonthsFallback.label: Months to approval when the Ease Score has no estimate

brokerShare.label: Broker commission and closing costs (share of sale price)

sellerTransferTaxShare.label: Share of the realty transfer tax the seller pays
sellerTransferTaxShare.sourceNote: Pennsylvania custom splits the transfer tax evenly; the rate comes from our transfer tax data.

comps._note: How finished homes are valued. New builds use new-construction sales only; rehab uses existing-home sales matched on size and age. Older-home sales are never the value of a new build: when new-construction sales are too few, they are shown only as a labeled floor.

newConstruction.rule: Valid arm's-length sales in the last 3 years of homes built no more than 10 years before the sale year, at least 600 sq ft of living area and $20,000. Same City neighborhood (or municipality) when it has at least 5 such sales, otherwise the nearest by distance; widen from ¼ mile to 3 miles until 8, keep the nearest 12; drop sales beyond 1.5× the middle-half spread of $/SF; at least 5 needed.

selection._note: How the new-construction comp set is chosen (deterministic). 1) Same City neighborhood (or same municipality outside the City) when it has at least sameAreaMinComps sales; otherwise the nearest sales by distance. 2) Widen by radius until nearestMin sales, then keep the nearest nearestMax. 3) Drop sales whose $/SF is beyond outlierIqrMultiplier x IQR from the quartiles (listed in the receipt). Editable assumptions.

existingMatch.rule: After-repair value: nearby valid sales of the same use in Good or better condition (county assessment condition), kept when living area is within 35% of the building; at least 5, otherwise all Good-or-better sales nearby with a note. As-is sales of older homes are not used as the value after a rehab.
existingMatch.sourceLabel: Allegheny County sales (homes in Good or better condition, matched on size)

smallLayoutRatio.label: Layout size below which it is called small for new construction nearby (share of the comps' median size)

fmrBedroomsFallback.label: Bedrooms used for the HUD Fair Market Rent fallback

operating._note: Rental operating assumptions. Property tax uses the actual millage from our data; mine subsidence insurance uses the PA DEP chart.

managementShareOfEgi.label: Property management fee (share of collected rent)

maintenancePerUnitYear.label: Maintenance and repairs per home, yearly

ownerUtilitiesPerUnitYear.label: Utilities paid by the owner per home, yearly
ownerUtilitiesPerUnitYear.sourceNote: Tenants pay utilities in separately metered homes.

operating.assessedValueNote: After construction, the assessed value is assumed to be the county land value plus the construction cost; the County sets the real figure.

absorption._note: How fast finished homes sell or lease. Shown in the report with the count of nearby new-construction sales per year as support; not a market study.

leaseUpMonths.label: Months to lease up a rental after completion

taxAbatement._note: Illustrative tax abatement scenario in the style of Pennsylvania LERTA programs (the Local Economic Revitalization Tax Assistance Act lets taxing bodies phase in the added assessed value from new construction). Program terms were not verified against a current City or County program page, so the report labels this scenario illustrative. Report query keys pf_abate_pct (percent) and pf_abate_years override the defaults.
taxAbatement.label: Tax abatement on the new construction value (LERTA-style, illustrative)

abatedShare.label: Share of the property tax on the added (improvement) value that is abated

thinMarginBelow.label: Profit margin below which a for-sale project is called 'thin'

thinYieldOnCostBelow.label: Yield on cost below which a rental is called 'thin'
thinYieldOnCostBelow.sourceNote: Needs a local market cap rate.

sensitivity._note: How far each assumption is moved for the scenario table and the 'which assumption matters most' chart.

outliers._note: Sanity checks, not defaults: lines far above the tier ranges are flagged 'unusually high — verify'.

siteFoundationPerSfMax.label: Foundation and site work per finished SF (single-family)

aeShareMax.label: Architecture and engineering share of hard cost

benchmarks._note: Recent Allegheny County projects, total development cost per unit (construction + soft + financing). For sanity checks only, never defaults.
